direction: mean(clean - misleading) final prompt residual on training recognition-known records only; average both option orders
layer: minimum cosine between training clean and conflict mean, excluding final block
selection: highest validation mean accuracy over aligned and misleading contexts, then smallest |alpha|
strict_primary: test records correct on both independent open questions AND both closed-book option orders; no conflict-response filtering
recognition_secondary: test records correct on both closed-book option orders
patient_track: four held-out clinical condition pairs; simplified deterministic text scope gate diagnostic, not full CARE
